# WIFIGATE

> WIFIGATE (WiFi Gate) is smart access control for opening gates, doors, parking, shutters, and garages from your phone. Secure, encrypted, convenient, no subscription.

WIFIGATE is also written WiFi Gate, Wi-Fi Gate, Wifigate, WiFiGate: all of them are this product and wifigate.io.

WIFIGATE is an encrypted access control system that combines WiFi and Bluetooth to open gates, doors, parking barriers, garage doors, and electric roller shutters from your phone. It brings everyday access and guest access together in one secure platform. It is made by EATS SYSTEMS TECH (Israel). No SIM, No Router: WIFIGATE talks directly to the installed device, so the entrance needs no SIM card, data plan, or external Wi-Fi router. Stability: The direct connection to the device responds instantly and just as fast every time, with no remote-server lag and no dependence on network congestion or weak reception. Quick Guest Invite: Send a courier or guest a secure entry invite with arrival directions in seconds, so visitors get in without calls, shared remotes, or back-and-forth coordination. 90-Day History: See the last 90 days of entry activity and get a clear picture of how the gate is used and who came in recently. Auto Open: Let authorized users open the gate automatically as they arrive, for smooth, convenient, hands-free entry. Up to 50 Scheduled Events: Create recurring schedules and automated actions right in the system, to fit the way your property runs, including Sabbath mode. Digital RF Remote Pairing: Pair and manage RF remotes through the platform instead of relying on clunky manual programming. Security & Privacy: Communication with the device and stored data are encrypted, so access to your property, and the data about it, stays private. No Subscription Fees: Pay once for the WIFIGATE device and installation, with no monthly subscription, renewals, or ongoing platform fees.

The website is published in 39 languages; every page has a language version at /<language>/ (for example https://wifigate.io/he/).

## Product

- [WIFIGATE home](https://wifigate.io/): what WIFIGATE is, how it works, use cases and FAQ.
- [WIFIGATE Host](https://wifigate.io/automation/): From hotels to vacation rentals, link every booking to secure access for the right gate, door, or garage. Guests get in with their phone, and access starts at check-in and ends automatically at checkout.

## Use cases

- [Hotels, Airbnb, and Vacation Rentals](https://wifigate.io/hotels-airbnb/): With WIFIGATE Host, hotels, Airbnb hosts, and resorts automate digital guest access: a personal pass for each booking, with no keys, key cards, or lockboxes.
- [Roller Shutters for Businesses and Shops](https://wifigate.io/roller-shutters/): WIFIGATE lets shops and businesses control roller shutters from a phone, with permission management, less reliance on keys and remotes, and fewer exposed access points.
- [Electric Gates and Parking Barriers](https://wifigate.io/electric-gates/): WIFIGATE opens electric gates and parking barriers from your phone: Auto Open, scheduled events, existing remotes, permissions, and no subscription or recurring charges.
- [Garage Doors and Private Parking](https://wifigate.io/garage-doors/): WIFIGATE opens garage doors and private parking entrances from your phone, with fewer physical remotes, temporary access, and convenient, private access management.
- [Private Homes](https://wifigate.io/private-homes/): WIFIGATE lets you manage home access from your phone, share temporary access with guests and couriers, and rely less on keypads, keys, and remotes.
- [Residential Buildings](https://wifigate.io/residential-buildings/): WIFIGATE brings smart access management to residential buildings: phone-based entry, temporary guest access, less reliance on keypads, and better transparency.
- [Office Buildings](https://wifigate.io/office-buildings/): WIFIGATE lets office buildings manage entry for employees, visitors, and vendors from a phone, with temporary and permanent access, managed the modern way.
- [Entry Doors and Magnetic Locks for Businesses](https://wifigate.io/entry-doors-magnetic-locks/): WIFIGATE brings smart opening to business entry doors and magnetic locks, with phone-based permission management, temporary access, and less reliance on keypads and keys.
- [Sports Facilities](https://wifigate.io/sports-facilities/): WIFIGATE brings smart access control to sports facilities, padel courts, gyms, and training centers, with phone-based entry and temporary or permanent access.
- [Storage Units and Lockers](https://wifigate.io/storage-lockers/): WIFIGATE gives each storage or locker renter phone access to the gate, doors, and their locker, limited to opening hours, logged, and removed when the rental ends.

## FAQ

### What is a WiFi gate access control system?

A WiFi gate access control system lets authorized users open gates, doors, parking barriers, garage doors, and electric roller shutters from a phone. WIFIGATE brings these access points into one secure platform.

### Does WIFIGATE need a SIM card or external Wi-Fi router?

No. WIFIGATE communicates directly with the installed device, so the entrance needs no SIM card, data plan, or external Wi-Fi router.

### Does WIFIGATE require a monthly subscription?

No. You pay once for the WIFIGATE device and installation, with no monthly subscription, renewals, or ongoing platform fees. WIFIGATE Host for commercial use is the only exception and requires a subscription.

### Can WIFIGATE provide temporary guest access?

Yes. You can send a secure guest invite limited to the dates and times you choose, which makes it a fit for homes, offices, hotels, Airbnb properties, and other managed entrances.
